identity.title: List of chapters in the FireRed & LeafGreen arc of Pokémon Adventures

plainText:
== ==
There are no titles given to chapters in this arc. Chuang Yi did not translate the Japanese subtitles. Titles are added when VIZ Media translated the chapters.
